The phrase "the teachings of a yogi" most commonly refers to the specific spiritual and lifestyle principles popularized by \[Yogi Bhajan\](https://www.google.com/search?q=yogi+bhajan&kgmid=/m/041fr7#) (the master who brought Kundalini Yoga to the West), but it can also encompass the universal philosophy of traditional yoga lineages like those taught by \[Paramahansa Yogananda\](https://www.google.com/search?q=paramahansa+yogananda&kgmid=/m/01241v#) or the ancient Yogic Sages. \[1, 2, 3, 4, 5\] 
\------------------------------
\## Core Pillars of Yogi Bhajan's Teachings
If you are referring to the well-known book \[The Teachings of Yogi Bhajan\](https://www.google.com/search?q=The+Teachings+of+Yogi+Bhajan&kgmid=/hkb/Cg4KCGxhbmd1YWdlEgJlbgoMCgR0eXBlEgRCT09LCisKC2VudGl0eV9uYW1lEhx0aGUgdGVhY2hpbmdzIG9mIHlvZ2kgYmhhamFu#), his philosophy centers around Kundalini Yoga, conscious living, and the unique concept of the "power of the spoken word". \[1, 6\] 

\* 
\* The Power of the Spoken Word: Words carry specific sound vibrations and rhythms that directly reflect and alter your state of consciousness. Speaking or chanting enlightened words out loud cleanses the subconscious mind of negative thought patterns. \[6, 7\] 
\* The 3HO Lifestyle: He founded the 3HO organization, which stands for Healthy, Happy, Holy. The core belief is that it is every human being's birthright to live a fulfilled, joyful, and spiritually connected life. \[8, 9, 10, 11, 12\] 
\* Householder Yoga: Unlike ancient yogis who isolated themselves in caves, his teachings encourage a practical, everyday life. He taught extensively on building balanced relationships, conscious parenting, healthy gender identities, and maintaining physical vitality. \[1, 3, 13, 14, 15\] 
\* Mental Resilience: One of his most famous credos is: "It’s not the life that matters, it’s the courage that you bring to it." His techniques aim to build mental grit to handle the stresses of the modern world. \[9, 16\] 
\* 

\------------------------------
\## Teachings from "Autobiography of a Yogi"
If you are looking at the teachings of \[Paramahansa Yogananda\](https://www.google.com/search?q=paramahansa+yogananda&kgmid=/m/01241v#) (author of the spiritual classic \[Autobiography of a Yogi\](https://www.google.com/search?q=autobiography+of+a+yogi&kgmid=/m/04bqvh#)), the focus shifts to Kriya Yoga and inner realization: \[2, 17, 18, 19, 20\] 

\* 
\* Mind Over Matter: Deeply held beliefs manifest in physical reality. By altering unconscious thought patterns and limiting beliefs, individuals can facilitate self-healing and unlock inner abundance.
\* Universal Consciousness: Our essential human nature is not a fragile physical body, but infinite, divine consciousness.
\* Meditation: Daily scientific meditation is the primary tool to clarify your mind and transition from mortality into an immortal spiritual awareness. \[2, 21, 22\] 
\* 

\------------------------------
\## Universal Truths of All Traditional Yogis
At its roots across thousands of years, traditional yogic philosophy (Sanatana Dharma) teaches a few core tenets: \[3, 23\] 

\* 
\* Turning Inward: True answers to identity, peace, and fulfillment cannot be found in the material, external world; they must be experienced internally through reflection.
\* Dissolving the Ego: Liberation comes from lowering the intensity of personal agendas and the ego, allowing oneself to experience oneness with everything.
\* Karma and Sadhana: Life is shaped by intentional action (Karma) and disciplined daily spiritual practice (Sadhana) to keep the body and mind clear. \[3, 24, 25, 26, 27\] 
\* 

Are you looking for information on a specific yogi (such as \[Yogi Bhajan\](https://www.google.com/search?q=yogi+bhajan&kgmid=/m/041fr7#), \[Yogananda\](https://www.google.com/search?q=yogananda&kgmid=/m/01241v#), or Sadhguru), or are you looking for practical yoga practices (like meditations or mantras) to try yourself?
